CustomField.formula:
Group_Name__c +' '+
CASE(Frequency__c ,'Weekly','Week ending','Fortnightly','Fortnight ending','Monthly','Month ending','None')
+' '+
CASE(MONTH( Period_End_Date__c ), 1, 'January', 2, 'February', 3, 'March', 4, 'April', 5, 'May', 6, 'June', 7, 'July', 8, 'August', 9, 'September', 10, 'October', 11, 'November', 12, 'December', 'None')+' '+
TEXT(DAY(Period_End_Date__c)) +', '+TEXT(YEAR(Period_End_Date__c ))
CustomField.label: Period
